Friendzy / Classic party games / The Question Game

How to play The Question Game

You can only respond with questions Have an entire conversation using only questions. No statements, no answers — just questions. The moment someone slips and makes a statement, they lose.

2–8 players~8 minWitty & IntenseMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Two players start a conversation.
  2. Every single thing you say must be a question.
  3. No statements. No answers. Only questions.
  4. If you pause for more than 5 seconds, you lose.
  5. If you make a statement, you lose. The winner picks the next topic.

Example round

  • 'Are you hungry?' → 'Why would I be hungry?' → 'When did you last eat?' → 'Does that matter right now?'
  • Someone gets frustrated and says 'I don't know!' → Eliminated.
  • Long chains: 'Have you seen that movie?' → 'Which one?' → 'The one with the boat?' → 'Does this really matter?'

Tips

  • Rhetorical questions are allowed and lethal: 'Are you really asking me that?'
  • Ask emotionally loaded questions to throw people off.
